title: Discover repository information from any path
objective: Add sdlc repository info --path <path> to walk from the supplied path through its parents until a Git repository is found and return stable local repository information.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation, processing, and per-task commits on the current repository.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to retrieve repository information for any path. Based on the path, recursively check the current and parent directories until a git repository is found and then return information about the repository. sdlc repository info --path Commit the work item.

Process the new work item, commit per task.

scope.name: repository-ancestor-discovery
scope.description: Walk from the supplied path through its current and parent directories until a Git repository boundary is found.
scope.reason: Callers may provide a file, nested directory, repository root, or path beneath a repository and should not need to know the repository root first.

scope.name: repository-info-command
scope.description: Add sdlc repository info --path <path> with stable plain and JSON output for the discovered repository.
scope.reason: Consumers need a single read-only command to identify the repository associated with an arbitrary local path.

scope.name: repository-response-contract
scope.description: Persist a closed versioned response schema for the inspected path, discovered repository root, Git directory, bare status, and origin metadata.
scope.reason: CLI JSON response objects require durable schemas and explicit metadata semantics.

nonGoals.name: repository-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not initialize repositories, write Git configuration, change remotes, checkout branches, or mutate repository files.
nonGoals.reason: The command is read-only discovery and metadata inspection.

nonGoals.name: remote-network-resolution
nonGoals.description: Do not contact remote providers or infer unavailable repository metadata from network services.
nonGoals.reason: Repository info must remain deterministic and local to the discovered Git repository.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-production-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not add HTTP services, persistence, deployment, or production release behavior.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0012 is limited to local path traversal and Git inspection.

items.name: ancestor-repository-discovery
items.description: The command must inspect the supplied path and recursively check its current and parent directories until it finds a Git repository.
items.reason: Repository association must work for files and directories at arbitrary nesting levels.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A file path nested inside the repository discovers the repository root and returns zero.
A repository directory path and a path outside any repository return stable results, with the latter returning a non-zero error.

items.name: repository-info-response
items.description: The command must return stable plain and JSON information for the inspected path and discovered repository.
items.reason: Callers need repository root, Git directory, bare status, and local origin information without parsing ad hoc command output.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The persisted response schema covers inspected fullPath, repositoryRoot, gitDir, isBare, and origin metadata with explicit nullable behavior.
JSON output identifies the discovered repository root as an absolute path and includes the local Git metadata without changing repository state.

items.name: selector-and-read-only-boundary
items.description: The command must require --path <path>, reject missing/duplicate/invalid paths consistently, and not mutate files or Git metadata.
items.reason: Repository discovery must be scoped, repeatable, and safe to call from arbitrary path contexts.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Focused tests cover missing and duplicate path options, nested file discovery, directory discovery, outside-repository errors, and unchanged Git state.

items.name: repository-info-validation
items.description: The implementation must include representative fresh-process validation for nested paths, repository root paths, and no-repository paths.
items.reason: The command crosses filesystem traversal and Git command boundaries and needs executable coverage for each outcome.

acceptanceCriteria.description: yarn test and fresh-process repository info checks pass for valid nested paths, valid repository directories, and invalid outside paths.
